capabilities.text: Type a note once and have it saved to CareCom and the ward flow sheet
capabilities.quote: I’d prefer the nurse to type the note into the new tool once, and have it saved to both CareCom and the ward flow sheet.

capabilities.text: Print a clean copy of the note for the ward board
capabilities.quote: The tool would print a clean, legible copy for the ward board, and send the exact same text to CareCom.

capabilities.text: Connect to CareCom
capabilities.quote: I’m pretty sure it needs to connect to CareCom—the main electronic health record—and the ward flow sheet

capabilities.text: Connect to the ward flow sheet
capabilities.quote: and the ward flow sheet, which is a printed and manually updated form used by all nurses on the shift.

capabilities.text: Capture the note on the ward flow sheet and push it to CareCom automatically
capabilities.quote: so the new tool should capture the note there and push it to CareCom automatically.

capabilities.text: Display a list of patients on the ward with names, bed numbers, and last note date/time
capabilities.quote: When a nurse opens the tool, they see a list of the patients on their ward, with their names, bed numbers, and the last note date and time.

capabilities.text: Allow nurse to tap a patient to start writing a note
capabilities.quote: They tap the patient they’re writing for—say, Mr. Patel in bed 3A—and then they’re taken to a clean, simple text box with a timestamp already filled in.

capabilities.text: Provide a clean, simple text box with a timestamp already filled in for note entry
capabilities.quote: and then they’re taken to a clean, simple text box with a timestamp already filled in.

capabilities.text: Include a 'Save and Print' button
capabilities.quote: There’s a “Save and Print” button at the bottom, and no other fields or menus—just the space to type

capabilities.text: Run on a tablet via a web browser
capabilities.quote: So I’d say the tool should run on a tablet via a web browser, like the other systems they use

capabilities.text: Work even if the Wi-Fi is a bit slow
capabilities.quote: and it should work even if the Wi-Fi is a bit slow.

capabilities.text: Be reliable and fast
capabilities.quote: I don’t need it to be fancy, just reliable and fast.

capabilities.text: Note is locked once saved
capabilities.quote: so I'll record that the note is locked once saved, and a correction would need a separate process.

capabilities.text: Version one ready by June 14th
capabilities.quote: I need version one by the end of next month—specifically, by Friday, June 14th

capabilities.text: Budget capped at £10,000
capabilities.quote: we can’t spend more than £10,000 on the tool

capabilities.text: Prefer off-the-shelf option if it meets needs
capabilities.quote: If the off-the-shelf option fits within that and works with CareCom and the printer, I’d go with that.

capabilities.text: Handle 60 active users simultaneously without slowing down
capabilities.quote: The tool should handle 60 active users at the same time without slowing down

capabilities.text: Encrypt data in transit
capabilities.quote: that means the tool must encrypt the data both in transit and at rest

capabilities.text: Encrypt data at rest
capabilities.quote: that means the tool must encrypt the data both in transit and at rest

capabilities.text: Keep access logs
capabilities.quote: keep access logs, and only allow authorised staff to view or edit notes.

capabilities.text: Allow only authorised staff to view or edit notes
capabilities.quote: and only allow authorised staff to view or edit notes.

capabilities.text: Nurses see only patients on their assigned ward
capabilities.quote: She only sees the patients on her assigned ward—no access to other wards’ patients

capabilities.text: Allow nurse to tap a patient's name and see a list of all past notes, sorted by date and time
capabilities.quote: So the tool must let a nurse tap a patient’s name and see a list of all past notes, sorted by date and time.

capabilities.text: Print a standard page with patient name, bed, timestamp, and note text
capabilities.quote: standard page with patient name, bed, timestamp, and note text.
